entities.name: Measurement Gap Configuration Procedure
entities.description: Procedure for UE to setup, release, and manage measurement gap configurations for FR1, FR2, and per-UE measurements based on network configuration.

entities.name: gapFR1
entities.description: Information element indicating FR1 measurement gap setup or release.

entities.name: gapFR2
entities.description: Information element indicating FR2 measurement gap setup or release.

entities.name: gapUE
entities.description: Information element indicating per-UE measurement gap setup or release.

entities.name: GapConfig
entities.description: Information element containing measurement gap configuration parameters including gapOffset, measGapId, and gapSharing.

entities.name: gapOffset
entities.description: Parameter used to calculate the first subframe of each measurement gap occurrence.

entities.name: measGapId
entities.description: Identifier used to associate measurement gap configurations.

entities.name: mgta
entities.description: Timing advance parameter applied to measurement gap occurrences.

entities.name: gapSharing
entities.description: Parameter for configuring gap sharing between different measurement types.

entities.name: Setup condition
entities.description: Condition where gapFR1, gapFR2, or gapUE is set to setup.

entities.name: Release condition
entities.description: Condition where gapFR1, gapFR2, or gapUE is set to release.

entities.name: Gap calculation formula
entities.description: Formula for calculating measurement gap occurrences: SFN mod T = FLOOR(gapOffset/10); subframe = gapOffset mod 10; with T = MGRP/10.

relations.description: Measurement gap configuration procedure uses gapFR1 IE for FR1 gap management.
Measurement gap configuration procedure uses gapFR2 IE for FR2 gap management.
Measurement gap configuration procedure uses gapUE IE for per-UE gap management.
GapConfig contains gapOffset parameter for gap timing calculation.
GapConfig contains measGapId for gap association.
GapConfig may contain gapSharing parameter for gap sharing configuration.
Setup condition establishes gap calculation using the specified formula.
Setup condition establishes application of timing advance mgta to gap occurrences.
Release condition establishes release of existing measurement gap configuration.
gapFR1 being set to setup guards the setup condition.
gapFR1 being set to release guards the release condition.
